verdict.rationale: GitBook has a dedicated first-party docs page titled "MCP servers for published docs" under its "AI for your readers" section, which directly matches a published site exposing its own MCP server for readers' agents. Note that gitbook-docs-14, gitbook-docs-33 and gitbook-probe-4 describe a separate authoring MCP for creating and editing sites, so they don't count toward this reader-facing story. Missing for 10: details of the exposed tools (search and page-content retrieval are not spelled out in the evidence), setup and authentication specifics, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the published-docs MCP endpoint works.
